text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. When I went to cheer on Sweep 
Tosho in her event—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since we were split up by class, 
we're on the same team today♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, let's all join forces together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Aiming for 1st place~☆ Fiiiiiight...—"

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, that team is so cute~âª I'm gonna 
cheer for those girls~!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone participating in the 
Umamusume vs. Fans Truck-Pulling Showdown, 
please gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no matter how many opponents there 
are, this team won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho proclaimed with utter 
confidence. Since this was an event 
against the fans, their victory was all 
but assured, however—

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it, I'll do it, I'll do iiiiiit! 
Today's the day I beat those Umamusume 
girls!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the fans versus the Umamusume. 
Which side will be the first to push their 
truck over the designated line this time?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No, no, no way?! Horse girls are 
made up of such tiny kids?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Plus the track is pretty big, right...?! 
Even if I win, it'd just make me look 
immature...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, take your positions—! The whistle of 
destiny is about to blow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (PEEEEEP!!)

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Everyone, get into position! We 
pull on the count of three! Readyyy...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of an opening from the 
fan team, the Umamusume carried the truck 
across in an instant!! A splendid 
victory!!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhhhhh...!! I lost agaaain this 
yeeear...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No waaaay...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so what if I'm small? Don't go 
judging me by my looks!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In everything, the one with real strength 
is the one who wins!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Yikes... She's strong, but that cheeky 
attitude of hers is something else...!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, look. That's Sweep Tosho! You 
know, the one who said she was going from 
the Yasuda Kinen to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Seeing my power just now 
made you realize I'm stronger than anyone 
else, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hyek, that jumping power is insane too...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Your eyes are completely round. Why 
not just keep them glued to me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a sweet dream at the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the exhibition! 
Participants for the official inter-class 
truck-pulling match, please gather on the 
track!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, I have to get going.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What?! That was just an exhibition?!
choice_data_list: Sweep, that was a great appeal!
That was a great appeal, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! I'm planning to show off an even 
more awesome appeal from now on!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the inter-class truck pull! First 
match is the Magic Hero Flower Jet Team 
versus the Helptastic Crew!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-san! Time for a fair-and-square 
showdown! After all, us Helpers are the 
favorites to win!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha. I'm throwing those exact words right 
back at you!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: On your marks... Get set...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (PEEEEEP!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: "Deeeeeyaaaaaaaah! Yaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
TWEEEET! The winners are the Helping Hand 
Squad!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, both teams, please return to 
your seats. Next up, the teams for round 
two are—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Working up a sweat feels so 
good!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Sweep-san. My muscles really came in 
handy, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...? Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: One more time!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeeh~~!? Isn't that definitely against 
the rules...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No no no no! I won't accept it unless we 
do it one more time! We're having a 
rematchhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as Sweep Tosho began throwing a 
tantrum, we hurried to pull her away from 
the track...

text_block_list.name: Sweep & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: "Deeeeeyaaaaaaaah! Yaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
TWEEEEEET! The winner is: Magic Hero 
Flower Jet Team!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible power and speed...! Even with 
such a huge difference in their 
physiques...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Where are all those muscles packed 
inside such a tiny body!?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Hey... do you think Sweep Tosho's 
seriously gonna win both the Yasuda Kinen 
and the Takarazuka Kinen...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufun, did you see that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, isn't she getting way too hyped 
up? Even though winning was a given.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're completely hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Sweep-chan is making a peace sign~! 
So cute~☆ I wonder if someone's taking a 
picture of her~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's take a photo of all four 
of us doing peace signs! I wanna post it 
on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Sure thing! Come on, Flower, get 
over here quick!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! So whose smartphone should we use 
to take the photo...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Mayano's the one for stuff like this! 
She's super good at taking photos, too!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Alright, here we go! Ready, set... Peace!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Peace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to Mayano Top Gun when she spoke 
to me later, after she uploaded the photo 
to social media, it spread around the 
world at lightning speed.
